Definition: of Latin origin; modest; Pudes (i.e. Pudens), a Christian:--Pudens.
BiblicalUsage: Pudens is a Christian in Rome, named once in Paul's last letter. In his final greetings Paul writes that Eubulus greets Timothy, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a single name in a farewell is still a place in the story, and Pudens is remembered because he stood with Paul at the end.
